animations.name: scaleIn
animations.description: Mega-menu scale-in animation for opening dropdown panels. Motion-safe animation triggered on data-[state=open]. JS/Radix-driven.

animations.name: scaleOut
animations.description: Mega-menu scale-out animation for closing dropdown panels. Motion-safe animation triggered on data-[state=closed]. JS/Radix-driven.

animations.name: enterMenu
animations.description: Menu content enter animation for sliding panels when switching between menu items. Triggered by data-[motion=from-end] and data-[motion=from-start]. JS/Radix-driven.

animations.name: exitMenu
animations.description: Menu content exit animation for sliding panels when switching between menu items. Triggered by data-[motion=to-end] and data-[motion=to-start]. JS/Radix-driven.

animations.name: disclaimer-extend
animations.description: Scroll-driven animation for disclaimer section that extends padding and translates element as user scrolls.

animations.name: disclaimer-divider-fade
animations.description: Scroll-driven opacity fade for disclaimer divider element, tied to --disclaimer-scroll timeline.

animations.name: react-loading-skeleton
animations.description: Shimmer effect for loading skeleton components. Translates highlight gradient across element.

animations.name: noise
animations.description: Film grain noise animation shifting background position rapidly for textured visual effect.

animations.name: moneyFall
animations.description: Falling animation with rotation for decorative money/particle elements. Uses CSS custom properties for opacity.

animations.name: spin
animations.description: Continuous 360-degree rotation for loading spinners. Linear infinite animation.

animations.name: global-transition
animations.css: transition: color 0.3s ease-out, background-color 0.3s ease-out, opacity 0.3s ease-out
animations.description: Standard 300ms ease-out transition used globally for color, background, and opacity state changes on interactive elements.

animations.name: books-hero-asset-enter
animations.description: Fade-in animation for Books hero section assets. Uses --books-hero-fade CSS variable for duration. JS-driven.

insights: The design system uses a comprehensive dark-neutral theme with semantic color tokens (surface-primary, text-default, border-frosted) enabling easy theme switching.
Navigation employs Radix UI primitives with motion-safe animations, showing accessibility-first approach to dropdown interactions.
Button hierarchy is clearly defined: primary (solid purple), tonal (semi-transparent purple), and ghost (transparent) variants with consistent 40px height and pill shapes (rounded-4xl/5xl).
